name: Hallucinated Image Narrator
effect: Talks as if the user had shared an image, a panel or a long earlier text ("as shown in your image", "on the right side", "the second image"). It keeps pulling in climate change, carbon footprints, crowds of people and social-good activism,
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
